name: Ghosthelm of the Wandering Seer - Aeldari

evidence.text: Relic: Ghosthelm of the Wandering Seer - Aeldari; Availability: Near-Unique; Effect: Aeldari Warlock or GM-approved Psyker. Once per long rest when Perils trigger, treat the severity result as Warp Static. After resolving it, reduce your Warp Pressure by your proficiency bonus, minimum 0.
